name: Should I choose privacy film or etched/frosted glass for my bathroom window?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose privacy film or etched/frosted glass for my bathroom window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between privacy film and etched/frosted glass for a bathroom window depends on permanence, cost, and light quality. Privacy film is a more affordable and less permanent option, offering flexibility if you change your mind. It's applied to existing glass. Etched or frosted glass, however, is a permanent glass replacement that provides a more upscale, integrated look and can diffuse light more uniformly. For a long-term, high-quality solution with superior light diffusion, etched glass is often preferred. For budget-friendliness and reversibility, film is a good choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Privacy film is a budget-friendly, temporary option applied to existing glass. Etched/frosted glass is a permanent, higher-quality replacement offering better light diffusion and a premium look. Choose based on permanence, cost, and desired aesthetic.
